subject: session date
fact: The events occur on the 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 9th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Yuk-Yuk
fact: Yuk-Yuk joins the group as a goblin guide promised 20 gold.
source_quote: Their group expanded to include two members, the curious goblins Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait. They were promised 20 gold

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait joins the group as a goblin guide promised 20 gold.
source_quote: Their group expanded to include two members, the curious goblins Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait. They were promised 20 gold

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar convinced Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait to follow him into the dangerous tunnels.
source_quote: Jimjar convinced them to follow him into the dangerous tunnels.

subject: Ripplebark
fact: Ripplebark is edible in its raw state and can be roasted to improve its nutty flavor.
source_quote: They find some Ripplebark that, despite its rotten fresh appearance, is entirely edible in its raw state and could be roasted to improve its nutty flavor.

subject: Ripplebark
fact: Scorched or burnt ripplebark turns black but is still edible.
source_quote: Scorched or burnt ripplebark turned black but was still edible.

subject: Ripplebark
fact: Ripplebark can neutralize disease germs.
source_quote: It could also neutralize disease germs.

subject: Waterorb
fact: The Waterorb is a fungus that grows in the Underdark in shallow water.
source_quote: the Waterorb is a fungus that grows in the Underdark in shallow water.

subject: Waterorb
fact: A mature Waterorb is bulbous in shape and bigger than a human head.
source_quote: When mature, it was bulbous in shape and bigger than a human head.

subject: Waterorb
fact: When squeezed and wrung out, a Waterorb yields about a gallon of potable water.
source_quote: If squeezed and wrung out, it yields about a gallon (almost four liters) of potable water.

subject: Waterorb
fact: The remaining husk of a Waterorb is bland and chewy like a sponge but edible.
source_quote: The remaining husk was bland and chewy like a sponge but edible

subject: Waterorb
fact: A Waterorb can be used to store water.
source_quote: But more importantly, it can be used to store water.

subject: Silken Tunnels
fact: The Silken Tunnels are behind the group as they enter the Underdark.
source_quote: The Silken Tunnels are behind them now, and the dark depths of the Underdark are ahead.

subject: Underdark
fact: The group enters the dark depths of the Underdark.
source_quote: the dark depths of the Underdark are ahead

subject: Faerzress magic effect
fact: Yuk-Yuk and Spiderbait notice the colors in the Faerzress-magic-rich tunnels are different than usual.
source_quote: Yuk Yuk and Spiderbait find the colors somehow different than they are used to.

subject: Thorin's madness
fact: Thorin suddenly screams, laughs, and weeps for about ten minutes due to the Underdark's effects.
source_quote: But it is Thorin who suddenly loses it abruptly. He starts screaming, laughing, and weeping. After about ten minutes...

subject: Thorin recovers from madness
fact: Thorin recovers from his episode and says, 'I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now.'
source_quote: he recovers. 'I have no idea what happened. But I am fine now.'

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened suggests Ploopploopeen can help Thorin.
source_quote: Shuushar the Awakened sees Thorin’s bout of madness and remarks that perhaps in Sloobludop, the archpriest Ploopploopeen can help.

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen is the archpriest of the Sea Mother in Sloobludop.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen is a follower of the Sea Mother

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters that 'Ploopploopeen' is a tongue twister.
source_quote: Grygum hears the name of the archpriest and mutters, 'That’s quite a bit of tongue twister.'

subject: bottomless gorge
fact: The group reaches a massive cavern with a bottomless gorge.
source_quote: he finds himself in a massive cavern with what appears to be a bottomless gorge.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir laments he cannot fly across the bottomless gorge.
source_quote: Zalthir mutters, 'If only I could fly, I could get across. But I don’t, and there is no way to climb across it.'

subject: Zalthir realizes cavern ceiling is climbable
fact: Zalthir realizes the cavern has a ceiling that allows climbing over the gorge.
source_quote: Zalthir looks up and suddenly realizes he’s in a cave with a ceiling that allows anyone to climb over the gorge.

subject: Thorin climbs to roof
fact: Thorin volunteers to climb to the roof of the cavern to cross the gorge.
source_quote: Thorin volunteers. As Thorin is about to start his climb...

subject: Jimjar and Grygum make bet
fact: Grygum asks Jimjar to bet whether Thorin will make it across.
source_quote: Grygum asks Jimjar - 'Wanna make a bet?'

subject: Thorin overhears bet
fact: Thorin overhears the bet between Grygum and Jimjar.
source_quote: Thorin overhears the bet and shrugs.

subject: Thorin ties rope and climbs
fact: Thorin ties a rope around his waist and begins climbing to the roof and across the gorge.
source_quote: He takes a rope, ties it around his waist, and then begins the hazardous sport of climbing to the roof of the cavern and then the gorge.

subject: Thorin reaches other side
fact: Thorin drops down on the other side of the gorge.
source_quote: He drops down as he gets to the other side of the gorge.

subject: Thorin claims bet won
fact: Thorin shouts, 'We don’t owe you any more money, Jimjar.'
source_quote: Thorin shouts, 'We don’t owe you any more money, Jimjar.'

subject: Bandits ambush Thorin
fact: Several humans hiding on the other side of the gorge attack Thorin with crossbows.
source_quote: Unfortunately, the darkness does not permit him to notice several humans hiding on the other side of the gorge who attack him with their crossbows.

subject: bandits
fact: The attackers are desperate bandits dressed in a mix of armor and clothing.
source_quote: The attackers appear to be desperate bandits dressed in a mix of armor and clothing

subject: bandits
fact: The bandits are armed with scimitars and crossbows.
source_quote: and armed with scimitars and crossbows.

subject: bandits
fact: The bandits' equipment suggests they have been in the Underdark for some time.
source_quote: Their equipment suggests they have been in the Underdark for some time.

subject: fight against bandits
fact: The fight against the bandits is short, brutal, and victorious.
source_quote: The fight is short, brutal, and victorious.

subject: water bladders
fact: Zalthir discovers water bladders on the bandit corpses as vital adventuring gear.
source_quote: Zalthir is pleased to discover many vital pieces of adventuring gear on the corpses, the most important of which are water bladders.

subject: tinderbox
fact: Jimjar is excited about finding a tinderbox on the bandit corpses.
source_quote: Jimjar, however, is excited about the tinderbox

subject: tinderbox
fact: Jimjar believes toasted Ripplebark is the best thing in the Underdark.
source_quote: Toasted Ripplebark, the best thing in the Underdark.

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: The group debates whether to leave the bandit corpses or dispose of them to avoid attracting trackers.
source_quote: Zalthir turns to the locals, 'Do we leave the bodies here, and will the ecosystem of monsters impede our pursuers? Or should we dispose of the bodies because it will be a trail?'

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believe monsters will be a hindrance if corpses are left.
source_quote: Jimjar, Topsy, and Turvy believe that the monsters will be a hindrance.

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: Shuushar believes trackers cannot discern anything from the circle of life.
source_quote: Shuushar feels that the notion that trackers can discern anything from what the circle of life is is absurd.

subject: disposal of corpses
fact: Buppido insists leaving the bodies will leave a trail.
source_quote: Buppido is emphatic that this will leave a trail.

subject: bodies dropped into gorge
fact: The group drops the bandit bodies into the bottomless gorge based on Zalthir’s trust in Buppido’s conviction.
source_quote: Zalthir believes Buppido. There is something about the Derro’s conviction. And so the bodies are dropped into the bottomless gorge.

subject: Stool identifies Nilhogg's nose
fact: Stool points out a mushroom he calls a Nilhogg's nose.
source_quote: Stool shouts, 'That’s a cool mushroom!' He calls the mushroom a Nilhogg's nose.

subject: Nilhogg's nose
fact: Nilhogg's nose is edible but does not fill you up.
source_quote: You can eat it, but it won’t fill you up.

subject: Nilhogg's nose
fact: After eating Nilhogg's nose, one’s sense of smell is enhanced.
source_quote: But after eating it, you can smell better and find good mushrooms and other smells. It’s like the smells become so much more.

subject: Nilhogg's nose
fact: Smelling a bad odor after eating Nilhogg's nose causes intense pain.
source_quote: But if you smell a bad smell, it hurts you a lot more.

subject: Nilhogg's nose
fact: Zalthir collects a bunch of Nilhogg's nose mushrooms.
source_quote: Zalthir collects a bunch.

subject: Thorin talks to Eldeth
fact: Thorin tries to talk to Eldeth in the evening.
source_quote: In the evening, Thorin tries to talk to Eldeth.

subject: Thorin's relationship with giants
fact: Eldeth finds Thorin’s relationship with giants off-putting.
source_quote: But the shield dwarf finds Thorin’s relationship with giants to be offputting.

subject: War of the Giants
fact: The War of the Giants followed the War of the Dragons and ended in a peculiar stalemate.
source_quote: The War of the Giants that happened after the War of the Dragons ended in a peculiar stalemate.

subject: War of the Giants
fact: The Ordning was re-established after the War of the Giants.
source_quote: Although the Ordning was re-established

subject: War of the Giants
fact: The giant civil war continued after the Ordning was re-established.
source_quote: the giant civil war continued.

subject: War of the Giants
fact: The War of the Giants had a devastating effect on the people of the North.
source_quote: And the effect on the people of the North was devastating.

subject: Thorin defends his relationship with giants
fact: Thorin says, 'But they were different giants!'
source_quote: Thorin says - 'But they were different giants!'

subject: session date
fact: The next day is the 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 10th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is frustrated by trudging through the dark but continues foraging.
source_quote: Another day in the dark,' mutters Eldeth. Her frustration at trudging through the dark will not stop her from finding plenty of food.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth's foraging makes her indispensable to the group.
source_quote: Her success as a forager has made her indispensable to the group.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth's ability to hide tracks may be why the group is still alive.
source_quote: Her ability to hide their tracks may be why they are still alive.

subject: Drow of Velkynvelve
fact: The Drow of Velkynvelve is now almost forgotten by the group.
source_quote: The Drow of Velkynvelve is now almost forgotten.

subject: Eldeth discovers Tinmmasks
fact: Eldeth stops the group and identifies a field of Tinmmasks mushrooms.
source_quote: Stop,' she shouts. She is standing in front of a cave covered with mushrooms. She shouts, 'Tinmmasks.'

subject: Tinmmasks
fact: Tinmmasks are squat toadstools growing to about two feet in width and height.
source_quote: a field of squat toadstools growing to about two feet in width and height.

subject: Tinmmasks
fact: Tinmmasks grow in clusters of no more than four.
source_quote: They are grouped in clusters, with no more than four in a cluster.

subject: Tinmmasks
fact: Tinmmasks have a beige-colored cap crossed with red and orange stripes.
source_quote: The mushroom has a beige-colored cap crossed with red and orange stripes.

subject: Tinmmasks
fact: Tinmmasks spew a cloud of spores when heavily damaged or uprooted.
source_quote: If it is heavily damaged or killed by uprooting, it spews a cloud of spores out to a radius of 15 ft.

subject: Tinmmasks
fact: The spores of Tinmmasks cause poisoning with effects identical to a confusion spell.
source_quote: All those within the cloud may be poisoned for about a minute and, when poisoned, are affected by the same effects of a confusion spell.

subject: Eldeth identifies bandit death cause
fact: Eldeth identifies a corpse as having been killed by Tinmmasks spores.
source_quote: She looks at a corpse, 'that’s what happened to that guy.'

subject: looting bandit corpse
fact: The escapees loot the corpse of the bandit who escaped the ambush.
source_quote: The escapees loot the corpse

subject: bandit corpse identified
fact: The group realizes the looted corpse is the bandit who escaped the ambush near the gorge.
source_quote: they realize he is the bandit who escaped from the ambush near the gorge.

subject: Buppido warns of bandit friends
fact: Buppido mutters that the escaped bandit had friends.
source_quote: He had friends,' mutters Buppido.

subject: bandits arrive under truce
fact: A group of bandits arrive under a flag of truce offering information.
source_quote: The friends show up. A group of bandits arrive under the flag of truce, offering information about how to get out of the Underdark.

subject: bandit leader's story
fact: The bandit leader claims they got lost exploring a dungeon.
source_quote: We were exploring a dungeon and made one too many wrong turns, ending up deeper into the ground than we wanted to.

subject: bandit leader's story
fact: Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir recognize the bandit leader's story as a fabrication.
source_quote: Grygum, Eldeth, and Zalthir realize that the story is a fabrication

subject: deal for information
fact: The bandit leader offers information about escaping the Underdark in exchange for food.
source_quote: He offers the information for food. The deal is agreed upon

subject: bandit reveals escape route
fact: The bandit leader says the best chance of escape is through Blingdenstone.
source_quote: he shares with him that the best chance of escape is through the town of Blingdenstone.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy finds the name 'Blingdenstone' off-putting.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy find the name off-putting.

subject: Turvy
fact: Turvy finds the name 'Blingdenstone' off-putting.
source_quote: Topsy and Turvy find the name off-putting.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is mildly disinterested in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: Jimjar is mildly disinterested.

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find treasure.
source_quote: Sethir insists they should check out the lost temple and find the treasure.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first to purchase equipment.
source_quote: Buppido insists on going to Gracklstugh first and suggests they can purchase the equipment they need to make it to Blingdenstone.

subject: Darklake travel
fact: Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than traveling in tunnels.
source_quote: Sethir observes that traveling along the Darklake is less treacherous than traveling in tunnels.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop.
source_quote: Shuushar says he has no interest in traveling past Sloobludop

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar may be willing to help with travel on the Darklake.
source_quote: but may be willing to help with travel in the Darklake.

subject: group falls asleep after debate
fact: The group tires of the debate and falls asleep.
source_quote: The debate continues, but eventually, everyone tires of it and falls asleep.

subject: Grygum and Jimjar make bet about tomb monsters
fact: Grygum asks Jimjar to bet they’ll find monsters in the tomb.
source_quote: Grygum, enjoying the taste of toasted Ripplebark, asks Jimjar, 'Wanna bet that we’ll find monsters in the tomb?'

subject: Jimjar responds to bet
fact: Jimjar responds that of course they’ll find monsters and questions what kind.
source_quote: Jimjar mutters, 'It’s a lost tomb; of course, we will; the better question is -what kind of monsters-.'

subject: Grygum suggests undead
fact: Grygum asks if the monsters will be undead.
source_quote: ‘Undead?’

subject: Jimjar dismisses undead
fact: Jimjar calls undead boring.
source_quote: ‘Boring.’

subject: Grygum suggests skeletons and zombies
fact: Grygum suggests skeletons and zombies as the monsters.
source_quote: ‘Skeletons and Zombies?’

subject: Jimjar accepts bet on skeletons and zombies
fact: Jimjar accepts the bet on skeletons and zombies.
source_quote: ‘I’ll take that bet.’

subject: Grygum asks what they're betting
fact: Grygum asks what they are betting on.
source_quote: ‘What are we bEttin g?’

subject: group silences Grygum and Jimjar
fact: The group tells Grygum and Jimjar to be quiet as they try to sleep.
source_quote: The two of them are told to be quiet by the rest of the group as it tries to sleep.

subject: session date
fact: The next day is the 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: group awakens to screaming
fact: The group wakes up to the sounds of screaming.
source_quote: The group wakes up to the sounds of screaming.

subject: Spiderbait discovers Yuk-Yuk's corpse
fact: Spiderbait stares at the ground at the corpse of Yuk-Yuk.
source_quote: Spiderbait is staring at the ground at his friend Yuk Yuk. The rest of the group examines the ground, and there is the corpse of Yuk Yuk

subject: Yuk-Yuk's throat is cut
fact: Yuk-Yuk’s throat is cut with a blade.
source_quote: his throat cut with a blade.

subject: Grygum examines Yuk-Yuk's wound
fact: Grygum examines the cut and identifies it as from a shortsword.
source_quote: Grygum examines the cut and notes, 'It’s a shortsword.'

subject: Grygum notes anyone could have done it
fact: Grygum says any one of the group could have done the killing.
source_quote: Any one of us could have done it.
